# fetchloom

> fetchloom puts the exact research data your project needs in `data/` on windows and linux. `data.toml` is your shopping list, `data.lock` is the receipt pinning each file by SHA-256 and size, and the shared cache is your pantry for reuse across projects.

## docs

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, sources, benchmarks and troubleshooting
- [cli](docs/cli.md): every command, option and output, plus archives, cache and environment settings
- [agents](docs/agents.md): --json recipes, error kinds, exit codes, the python helper and offline use
- [formats](docs/formats.md): data.toml, data.lock, cache records, environment settings and the JSON contract
- [scope](docs/scope.md): supported sources, platforms and limits
